capabilities: Clip a pasted web page URL into a Markdown note via ribbon icon or command palette
Extract the article body and remove ads, navigation, footers, and other noise
Generate YAML front matter with title, source URL, author, date, and excerpt
Clip a URL directly from the clipboard
Configure save path, filename templates, and front matter fields
extras: Cannot clip pages that require JavaScript rendering or login (e.g. Notion, GitHub Discussions); images keep original URLs and may be blocked by hotlink protection. Roadmap items (local image download, batch clipping, custom cleaning rules) are not yet implemented.
motivation: The author says Obsidian has lacked a good web clipper and built this as a pure in-app solution with zero external dependencies.
problem: Existing Obsidian clipping options require browser extensions, third-party services, or command-line tools, or produce poor extraction quality.

relations.evidence: Content extraction: Mozilla's Readability.js — the same engine behind Firefox Reader View
Markdown conversion: Turndown with GFM plugin

summary: Web clipper that converts a pasted URL into a clean Markdown note inside Obsidian, extracting the article body and stripping ads and navigation.
